userStories.title: Full codebase review against live trading spec
userStories.description:
Audit the Range Trader application for production readiness. Review all scripts: range_execute.py, range_scanner.py, range_signal_filter.py, range_exit_monitor.py, range_verifier.py, run_range_pipeline.py, support_resistance.py, range_positions.py, range_reconcile.py.

System overview: Range Trader trades ZEN/VFY pairs on Base via Aerodrome. Positions sized at $500 range width targets. Exits when price exits range or SM flow turns negative. Uses Nansen for token data. Keys: RANGE_WALLET_ADDRESS and ZEN/VFY token addresses.
